_comment: Warren multi-hop control messages (marker 0xC0 + version 0x03 + postcard payload). v3 adds the DAITA capability echo: wants_daita on IpRequest/IpRequestV7, and daita_spec on IpAssign. daita_spec present = the exit granted the traffic-analysis defense and is driving that maybenot machine on its downlink; absent = the defense is NOT running, which the client must surface instead of padding nothing.

vectors.name: ip_request_minimal
vectors._comment: IpRequest with every option absent: variant tag 0, then four None/false bytes.

vectors.name: ip_request_full
vectors._comment: IpRequest: prefer_ipv4 Some(10.66.0.42), client_pubkey Some(0x42*32), wants_ipv6 true, pop_sig Some(0xa5*64 raw, no length prefix). wants_daita true.

vectors.name: ip_assign
vectors._comment: IpAssign: ipv4 10.66.0.7, prefix_len 24, gateway 10.66.0.1, no IPv6. daita_spec absent: the exit did not grant DAITA.

vectors.name: rejected_banned_unspecified
vectors._comment: RejectedBanned (account revoked / banned on the exit's signed CRL): variant tag 6, then a u8 reason_code. reason_code 0 = unspecified (generic suspension). The code is opaque to the engine; the deployer's control-plane assigns its meaning and the client maps it to a localized suspension message. Distinct from 'rejected' (tag 3, renewable) so the client shows a suspension, not a renew prompt.

vectors.name: rejected_banned_port_forwarding
vectors._comment: RejectedBanned with reason_code 1 = port-forwarding abuse (the Warren control-plane's coded reason): same variant tag 6, the trailing u8 carries the specific reason so the client can show a forwarded-port-specific suspension. An unrecognized code decodes fine and falls back to the generic message.

vectors.name: exit_draining
vectors._comment: ExitDraining (ADR 36, mid-session drain advisory): variant tag 4, then postcard(u64 deadline_unix_secs as LEB128 varint) + u8 reason_code. deadline 1700000120, reason 0.

vectors.name: ip_assign_with_daita
vectors._comment: IpAssign granting the traffic-analysis defense: daita_spec carries the maybenot machine the exit sampled for THIS session (it drives the same spec on its downlink; the client drives it on its uplink). Synthetic machine string, not a production spec.

vectors.name: ip_request_route_minimal
vectors._comment: IpRequestRoute (doc 107 section 7.1): variant tag 7, prefer_ipv4 None, wants_ipv6 false, the 81-byte route locator raw (the locator_seal of route_admission_v1.json), wants_daita false. No token, no wallet key, no proof of possession. Discriminants 0 to 6 keep their bytes: the variant is appended.

vectors.name: ip_request_route_full
vectors._comment: IpRequestRoute with prefer_ipv4 Some(10.66.0.42), wants_ipv6 true, wants_daita true. Discriminants 0 to 6 keep their bytes: the variant is appended.

vectors.name: route_rejected_anchor_unknown
vectors._comment: RouteRejected (section 7.2): variant tag 8, reason_code 1 = anchor unknown. Codes: 0 unspecified, 1 anchor unknown, 2 route limit, 3 not offered, 4 unavailable. Discriminants 0 to 6 keep their bytes: the variant is appended.

vectors.name: route_rejected_route_limit
vectors._comment: RouteRejected with reason_code 2 = route limit. Discriminants 0 to 6 keep their bytes: the variant is appended.

vectors.name: route_anchor_request
vectors._comment: RouteAnchorRequest (section 7.3): variant tag 9, the 81-byte sealed anchor raw (the anchor_seal of route_admission_v1.json), session_token None. 85 bytes. Discriminants 0 to 6 keep their bytes: the variant is appended.

vectors.name: route_anchor_request_with_token
vectors._comment: RouteAnchorRequest carrying a session token after a needs_token ack: Some, then the 354 raw token bytes with no length prefix, as in IpRequestV7. 439 bytes. Discriminants 0 to 6 keep their bytes: the variant is appended.

vectors.name: route_anchor_ack_bound
vectors._comment: RouteAnchorAck (section 7.4): variant tag 10, status 0 = bound, max_routes 256 as a postcard varint (two bytes, 0x80 0x02). Status: 0 bound, 1 needs token, 2 not eligible, 3 refused, 4 unavailable, 5 lost. Discriminants 0 to 6 keep their bytes: the variant is appended.

vectors.name: route_anchor_ack_lost
vectors._comment: RouteAnchorAck with status 5 = lost (the exit's renewal found no anchor; the client resends its request) and max_routes 0. Discriminants 0 to 6 keep their bytes: the variant is appended.

vectors.name: route_ended_anchor_gone
vectors._comment: RouteEnded (section 7.5): variant tag 11, reason_code 1 = anchor gone. Codes: 0 unspecified, 1 anchor gone, 2 closed by policy. Discriminants 0 to 6 keep their bytes: the variant is appended.
